witnesses.edition: Oscar von Gebhardt, Acta martyrum selecta (Berlin: A. Duncker, 1902)
witnesses.local_path: sources (scan read online; archive.org djvu text corrected against the printed Latin)
witnesses.note: Passio sanctorum Scillitanorum, pp. 92-96, sections 1-17. Latin text read from the scan text layer and corrected where OCR garbled letters (e.g. eognosco -> cognosco, proeonsul -> proconsul); every correction is letter-level, no wording supplied. Gebhardt's apparatus is recorded in the source JSON variants.
